title: README's lore check --json example shows a check.report shape that does not exist
description: Found by the reviewer pass on LCLI-571, 2026-09-25, and not re-run by this session. README.md's 'lore check --json' example shows schemaVersion as the string "1" and data keys ok/drift/brokenLinks/portability. The real output after the quickstart is {"schemaVersion":1,"kind":"check.report","data":{"findings":[],"errorCount":0,...}}. The README ships in the npm tarball. LCLI-571's quickstart gate covers the commands between the markers, not the example outputs below them.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The README check.report example matches real lore check --json output for the quickstart repository, verified by running it

implementationNotes: Evidence, 2026-09-25, lore 0.9.3 built from dev ad9a14ad (bun run build), quest 0.10.0. I replayed README.md's quickstart block verbatim (the same extraction as scripts/readme-quickstart.sh) in a fresh scratch repo, exit 0, then ran 'lore check --json' there: {"schemaVersion":1,"kind":"check.report","data":{"findings":[],"errorCount":0,"warningCount":0,"fileCount":8,"skippedOutOfBundleLinkCount":0,"complete":true},"principal":null}, exit 0. The README example is now that output, pretty-printed and byte-for-byte in values. The added finding example is also real: I appended a broken link to the quickstart story and got {severity:error, rule:broken-link, ...}, exit 6. The adjacent 'lore tasks ... --plain' example was checked the same way and already matched, so it is unchanged. Gates: scripts/readme-quickstart.sh exit 0; shipped-readme-version --check exit 0; README-reading tests 203 pass; bun run lore check exit 0. The mechanical version of this check is filed as LCLI-588.
finalSummary: README.md's 'lore check --json' example showed a check.report shape that does not exist: schemaVersion as the string "1", and data keys ok/drift/brokenLinks/portability. It now shows the real output of 'lore check --json' on the README quickstart repository, measured by replaying the quickstart verbatim with a freshly built lore 0.9.3. It also shows one real finding entry, with a note that errors exit 6. Delivered in the PR for branch docs/LCLI-583-readme-check-json-example. The README ships in the npm tarball, so this corrects published documentation from the next release on. Follow-up LCLI-588 makes the quickstart gate compare example outputs, so this cannot drift silently again.
